description: At Space4All, our mission is to transform complex space engineering into an engaging, interactive, and educational experience. We aim to build an open-source space mission simulator that allows users to design missions, allocate limited resources, make critical engineering decisions, and experience how those choices affect mission outcomes.
summary:
ORBITALIS: BEYOND THE ORBIT is a 3D, story-driven space mission design game that puts players in the role of a crew commander on a fictional lunar south-pole expedition. Instead of simply planning a mission through charts and dashboards, players experience the journey through spacecraft configuration, crew interactions, launch, spaceflight, emergency response, lunar landing, and scientific exploration.
The game addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by turning complex mission-design concepts into interactive decisions. Players must balance spacecraft mass, fuel, propulsion, power, budget, and crew safety while facing realistic operational trade-offs and mission consequences. An engineering failure analysis system helps players understand what went wrong and how to improve their next attempt.
ORBITALIS makes space engineering more accessible and engaging by combining scientific learning, problem-solving, and immersive storytelling game.
details:
Project Details: ORBITALIS – BEYOND THE ORBIT

ORBITALIS is an immersive 3D space exploration game where players experience the challenges of planning and completing a lunar mission. Players prepare spacecraft, manage resources, solve engineering challenges, launch into space, and explore the Moon.

Benefits: The project promotes STEM education, creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and resource management through interactive gameplay.

Intended Impact: Our goal is to inspire young people to learn about space science, engineering, and technology through an engaging educational gaming experience.

Tools and Technologies: Godot Engine, GDScript, Blender, and 3D game assets.

Creativity: The game combines space adventure, realistic mission challenges, spacecraft engineering, and interactive lunar exploration.

Team Considerations: We focused on educational value, user experience, accessibility, performance, teamwork, and creating an enjoyable gaming experience.
